```{r}
#| include: true
# Targets
Target <- .currentTarget("ID.target")
ID.target <- .resolveDerivedIDTarget(
  kmaxTable,
  "kh.qmd table",
  suffix = ".max",
  target = Target,
  siteID = .currentTarget("siteID.target")
)
if (!exists("IDg.target")) IDg.target <- IDg.gmdp
if (!exists("Da.target"))  Da.target  <- sort(Da.gmdp)
if (!exists("IDn.target")) IDn.target <- "ensemble"
if (!exists("TR.target"))  TR.target  <- 10000
if (!exists("p.target"))   p.target   <- "mean"
root <- here::here()
IDn.label <- IDn.target
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- "Performance-based seismic coefficients $k_h$ [%%PGA] for the %s Newmark scenario as function of admissible residual displacement $D_a$ [cm]. Values are reported for target ground motion with 1/%.0f AEP [1/yr]."
```

```{r}
#| include: true
#| tbl-cap: !expr CAP |> sprintf(IDn.label, TR.target)
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "tbl/kh.R"))
TBL
```

```{r}
#| include: false
rm(ID.target, IDg.target, Da.target, TR.target, CAP, IDn.label)
if (exists("Target", inherits = FALSE) && length(Target)) ID.target <- Target
rm(list = intersect("Target", ls()))
```
